verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents custom templates, which capture a machine and its configuration so you can create new machines with your specifications, and you can pick a custom template at machine creation. Deployments are documented as running container images, but only for serving models; the evidence never confirms bringing your own Docker image as a development environment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-supplied/custom Docker images for Machines or Notebooks, details on how to build and share templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration that templates reproduce an exact environment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: Custom templates are templates of your machines and their configurations. You can use these custom templates to create new machines with your specifications.
When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template
Deployments are containers-as-a-service that let you run container images and serve machine learning models.
